name: Can a new garage addition include features like a separate entrance or bathroom?

mainEntity.name: Can a new garage addition include features like a separate entrance or bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, a new garage addition can certainly include customized features such as a separate entrance, a bathroom, or even a kitchenette, especially if it's intended for multi-generational living, a dedicated home office, or a rental unit (ADU). These elements enhance functionality and value, providing greater independence and utility for the new space. Integrating such features requires careful planning for plumbing, electrical, and structural changes, all of which are managed within AKN Design Group's comprehensive design-build process. We ensure these additions comply with all building codes and local regulations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, new garage additions can include customized features like separate entrances or bathrooms, especially for multi-generational living or ADUs. These require careful planning and permit coordination.
